items.t: How Did AbbVie's Immunology Franchise Fare in Q3?

items.t: AbbVie (ABBV) Reports Positive Phase 3 QULIPTA Migraine Trial Results
items.sum: AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) reported positive Phase 3 TEMPLE trial results for QULIPTA in migraine prevention against topiramate. The TEMPLE study found QULIPTA achieved superior tolerability compared with topiramate in adults with migraine.
